page.layout: One page of running text in one column. Running head at top centre. No margin notes. Catchword and signature at the foot right.

main_text.p: seculis aliquot post Gabriel Angelus Mariae virgini dixit: Apud Deum non erit impos-sibile omne verbum.Luc.1.37.

Meminerimus autem, hoc loco nobis, intuentibus triftia spectacula, confusionū & calamitatum humani generis, potentia & astutiam hostium Ecclesiae, immanitate & successus Turcorum & aliorum, ad Deū solum esse confugiendum, non ad humana praesidia, quae ficulna esse consueverunt: ac petendum a Domino, ut, propter sanctū nomen suum, mitigare dignetur publicas & privatas calamitates, ut nobis alicubi concedat halcedonia & tranquillas sedes, in quibus propagari vera doctrina possit.
main_text.head: THESIS DE MILITANTE Ecclesia.
main_text.p: Ecclesia militans, mirabiliter seruatur, & benedictione coelesti, divinitus instruitur.

Etsi autem ut in acie, nunc huc, nunc illū gladius absumit: sic nunc hunc sanctum, nunc illum morte sua Deum glorificare oportet. Ioan.21.19. tamen, species, hoc est, Ecclesia colligitur, coseruatur & inter medias ef florescit persequutionū & aliarum multiplicium aerunarum spinas.
1. Fieri enim non potest, ut non etiàdant sancti, hoc est, sanctificati de mundo, quib.

page.notes: Running head is "COMMENTARIA." with a page number at top right that is hard to read; 113 is my best reading. Catchword "etiam" and signature "H" read at the foot right. Doubtful: "etiàdant" at the line end (the last letters of "etiam" and "dant" are not clear); "ef" for est (printed as ef, possibly a misprint); "possit." end-of-sentence mark; "quib." ends the page with the word unfinished, as printed. The "1." thesis number is kept as a paragraph. Long s is rendered as s throughout. Thesis heading is level 2 as a title above a passage.
